description:
Sign up to the Godforge Early Access waitlist and join a game community of thousands of excited game fans ready to battle with the Gods of the past: http://fateless.studio/squidmar

We set out to build a massive miniature diorama, featuring a massive dragon that puts warhammer minis to shame. But the question is, can we make something that could make the man with the worlds biggest miniature & warhammer collection happy?
